feeds.title: Harmony Family Yoga Blog
feeds.description: Harmony Family Yoga, situated in Thousand Oaks, is a boutique yoga studio offering inclusive and holistic experiences. Embracing the traditions of yoga and meditation, it embodies the concept of harmony. Their mission is to cultivate balanced well-being within individuals, families, and the wider community.

feeds.title: Bikram Yoga San Jose Blog
feeds.description: Michele initiated Bikram Yoga San Jose in 2003, aspiring to enhance health and well-being through top-notch Bikram Yoga instruction. With certified and experienced teachers, their commitment to continuous learning ensures optimal service. The blog shares insights, practice-related articles, and member testimonials.

feeds.title: Sivananda Yoga Farm Blog
feeds.description: Situated in Grass Valley, California, just an hour's drive from Sacramento, Sivananda Yoga Farm serves as a serene sanctuary for individuals worldwide to delve into yoga, meditation, and self-discovery. Rooted in the teachings of Swami Sivananda and Swami Vishnudevananda, their blog shares insights from senior teachers like Swami Sitaramananda, offering a wealth of articles, videos, and talks to support spiritual growth.

feeds.title: Pilgrimage of the Heart Yoga Blog
feeds.description: Pilgrimage of the Heart Yoga, located in San Diego, is dedicated to serving the community with a diverse range of classes for all levels in a clean and inclusive environment. Their supportive staff and instructors offer expertise and care to aid in the evolution of each practitioner's yoga journey. Explore insights on yoga, meditation, mindfulness, and breath work through their blog.

feeds.title: Be Yoga And Wellness Blog
feeds.description: Be Yoga and Wellness fosters an inclusive community, embracing individuals of all backgrounds and abilities. Rooted in heart-centred Hatha yoga, the studio emphasizes growth, prosperity, and thriving together. Recognizing the transformative power within, they offer a diverse range of classes to deepen the mind-body connection and support health goals for all. Stay updated with studio news and insights from their teachers on the blog.

feeds.title: Center For Yoga Blog
feeds.description: Established in 1967, the Center for Yoga stands as a premier studio on the West Coast and among the top in the US. Committed to teaching excellence and community service, it fosters personal growth by meeting clients where they are. The community-owned operation emphasizes transparency and deeper connections, offering insightful articles from teachers, owners, and community members on their blogs.

feeds.title: Bikram Yoga Palm Desert Blog
feeds.description: Bikram Yoga EL Paseo, Palm Desert's Original Bikram Yoga Studio, founded over 15 years ago, is renowned as the 'Students Studio.' With a loyal local and out-of-town following, it offers a community-focused environment for students of all levels to learn and practice Bikram Yoga comfortably.

feeds.title: Spiritually Fit Yoga
feeds.description: As of 2022, Amelia established Spiritually Fit Yoga RYS, leading 200hr Yoga Teacher Training and retreats globally. While teaching vinyasa and yin classes in the San Francisco Bay Area and on Insight Timer, she aims to guide individuals towards their best selves through yoga, meditation, reiki, and transformative events.

feeds.title: Yoga Trade Blog
feeds.description: Yoga Trade fosters connections between instructors, students, and wellness professionals worldwide, offering job and work trade opportunities. Their platform promotes community-building and positive action globally, enriching individuals and societies. Through resources and education, they support professional growth and inspire transformative experiences in yoga and wellness.

feeds.title: Soul of Yoga Blog
feeds.description: The Soul of Yoga, an esteemed global yoga institute, offers transformative experiences and comprehensive teacher training. With profound yogic teachings and expert insights, they empower practitioners worldwide. Delve into their articles, research reviews, and videos to enrich your journey.

feeds.title: Purple Yoga Blog
feeds.description: Purple Yoga provides inclusive classes for all levels, aiming to support individuals in their journey towards self-improvement. Their passionate team prioritizes continuous learning, fostering a community-centred approach to yoga and wellness. Gain valuable insights and education from Purple Yoga's experienced teachers and staff through their blog.

feeds.title: The Foundry Yoga Blog
feeds.description: The Foundry's blog covers diverse topics from member highlights to lifestyle tips, advocating growth and evolution over the path of least resistance. Each class sparks personal transformation, igniting possibilities. Gain insights into wellness and beyond through their blog.

feeds.title: three dog yoga Blog
feeds.description: Three Dog Yoga offers inclusive yoga classes suitable for all levels and aspirations. Their podcasts, ranging from 5 to 75 minutes, cover various themes like meditation, core strengthening, and relaxation, available for free worldwide. Rooted in the belief that feeling good in one's skin leads to a better life, they promote peace, resilience, and playfulness through their practices.

feeds.title: LA Yoga Magazine » Yoga
feeds.description: LA Yoga Ayurveda and Health Magazine serves as a valuable resource for Southern California's dynamic Yoga community. Through print, digital editions, online platforms, and newsletters, it shares inspirational narratives that bridge Yoga, practitioners, and its contemporary relevance in our lives.

feeds.title: EverydayYoga.com Blog
feeds.description: The Official Blog of EverydayYoga.com is the go-to source for the latest news, events, trends, and product updates. With a diverse range of top-of-the-line products, it caters to yogis of all levels, offering a yoga wonderland experience right at their fingertips.

feeds.title: Outdoor Yoga Journal
feeds.description: Outdoor Yoga, founded by Julianne Aiello in 2015, offers immersive yoga experiences led by the Bay Area's dedicated teachers. Their mission is to inspire wonder and togetherness, creating safe spaces for students to belong outside studio walls. With soulful music and nature immersion, they connect participants with the magic within and around them.

feeds.title: Power of Your Om Blog
feeds.description: Power of Your Om offers inviting and inclusive yoga programs for courageous exploration of the body and emotions. Their vision is a world where individuals and communities evolve collectively. Connect with the PoYO Santa Barbara community through their blog for studio updates, community insights, teacher training, and yoga practice tips.

feeds.title: Yoga by Paige Blog
feeds.description: Paige, a 500-hour Yoga Therapeutic Specialist certified in Yoga Medicine, shares her expertise to aid others through yoga. With nearly two decades of experience, she fosters transformation in her students' practice. Her playful yet knowledgeable approach caters to individual needs, making yoga accessible to all levels.

feeds.title: Trilogy Sanctuary Blog
feeds.description: Trilogy Sanctuary, founded by Joe and Leila, offers a sanctuary in La Jolla, San Diego, promoting balance, community, and healthy living. Through yoga, vegan cuisine, and spiritual healing, they foster connection and well-being. Explore their blog for vegan recipes, yoga tips, meditation guidance, fashion, and more.

feeds.title: Kate Brown Yoga Blog
feeds.description: At Kate Brown Yoga, individuals find a nurturing environment for holistic yoga experiences, both in group settings and one-on-one sessions. With an emphasis on essential yoga practices, students explore poses, breathwork, meditation, chanting, and reflection, fostering ease, strength, balance, and harmony. Classes are characterized by creativity, expression, and a foundation in personal choice, recognizing its sanctity in the yoga journey.

feeds.title: Seaside Yoga Sanctuary Blog
feeds.description: Seaside Yoga Sanctuary provides diverse yoga classes for all levels, promoting physical and mental well-being. With daily group sessions, private instruction, workshops, and teacher training, they cater to various needs. Stay updated on studio news through their blog and engage with the community.

feeds.title: Yoga for Times of Change Blog
feeds.description: Nina Zolotow, RYT500, MFA, serves as the Editor in Chief of the Yoga for Healthy Aging blog, contributing insightful articles. With a background as a certified yoga teacher and extensive experience in yoga for emotional well-being and healthy ageing, she also authored the widely available book, 'Yoga for Times of Change.' Nina conducts workshops on stress, anxiety, better sleep, and home practice, focusing on cultivating equanimity.

feeds.title: Ganja Yoga
feeds.description: Ganja Yoga, founded in 2009 by Dee Dussault, is a global brand promoting cannabis-enhanced spirituality. With certified instructors worldwide, they offer safe yoga experiences integrating plant medicines to facilitate deep relaxation and holistic well-being for individuals from all backgrounds.
